subject: Gartner technical deep-dive: customer sandbox access and runbook
messages:
From: laura-bennett@redwood.ai
To: samir.patel@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, pnair@gartner.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Gartner technical deep-dive: customer sandbox access and runbook

Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to the Gartner deep-dive. Priya (Gartner) will want a short technical session against a live/representative environment so they can validate performance claims and ask architecture questions. To make that productive we typically ask customers to provide: a short runbook, a network diagram, and a temporary read-only role or ephemeral creds scoped to the demo dataset (non-production).

Can you confirm whether AcmeCloud can:
- Provide a temporary IAM role or service account with read-only access to the demo cluster (expiry <= 48 hours)
- Share the network diagram and a brief runbook (5–7 bullets) describing the demo steps and expected query profiles
- Provide the security contact who will join if Gartner asks about data handling

Proposed slot for the deep-dive: Wed, Dec 1, 2027, 09:00–10:00 PT. If that works we will send the calendar invite and a short checklist.

Attaching a short playbook from Redwood that describes how we handle non-prod demos.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
laura-bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-sandbox-access-playbook.pdf (stub)

From: samir.patel@acmecloud.com
To: laura-bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmecloud.com, pnair@gartner.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gartner technical deep-dive: customer sandbox access and runbook

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the note. We can support a short hands-on session. Quick answers:
- We can provision a temporary role scoped to the demo cluster. Security prefers an ephemeral STS-style role that expires in 36 hours; fine to create it with read-only permissions.
- Attaching the network diagram and a contacts CSV for our security and ops folks.
- Wed Dec 1 09:00 PT works for us; I’ll tentatively block the slot.

One ask from our side: can Gartner (Priya) and Redwood confirm they will not request production logs or customer PII during the session? Our compliance team needs that constraint documented.

I’ve looped in our security contact (security@acmecloud.com) to coordinate the IAM details.

—Samir Patel
Director, Cloud Architecture
AcmeCloud
Attachment: acme-network-diagram.pdf (stub)
Attachment: acme-security-contacts.csv (stub)

From: laura-bennett@redwood.ai
To: pnair@gartner.com, samir.patel@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gartner technical deep-dive: customer sandbox access and runbook

Priya / Samir —

Appreciate the quick responses. Short answers to Samir’s ask: Redwood and Gartner will not request production logs or PII during the demo. The session will focus on architecture, model serving performance, and request/response profiles. We’ll add that constraint to the calendar invite and to the temporary access request.

Karthik — can you draft the least-privilege policy we should ask Acme to attach to the temporary role? A simple list (S3 read on demo-bucket, Describe/Read on the inference cluster, no write/delete) is fine.

Marissa — I’ll need you to include the run-of-show and the one-page checklist for the analyst (4 bullets). I attached Redwood’s sandbox playbook for your reference. If possible, Marissa can host the first 10 minutes to set context, then hand to Priya for questions and then Samir for a short walkthrough.

Samir — when the role is ready please share the ARN or a short credential stub and the expiry. Also, if security prefers a pre-signed access window rather than an IAM role, let us know — we can work with that.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachment: redwood-sandbox-access-playbook.pdf (stub)

From: pnair@gartner.com
To: laura-bennett@redwood.ai, samir.patel@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gartner technical deep-dive: customer sandbox access and runbook

Laura / Samir —

Thanks — I confirm Gartner’s intent: no production customer data or logs. The session will be a technical review to validate configuration and performance claims for our notes. My proposed agenda (30–45 minutes):
1) 5m intros and objectives (Marissa/Laura)
2) 10–15m customer architecture walkthrough (Samir)
3) 10–15m live demo of representative queries and latency profiles (Samir/Marissa)
4) 5–10m clarifying questions and next steps

If the temporary role can be scoped to read-only and expires within 48 hours, that works for our evaluation. I’ll join the session and take notes for the research team.

Priya Nair
Principal Analyst, Cloud Infrastructure
Gartner
priya.nair@gartner.com

P.S. Please include a calendar invite and the run-of-show 24 hours before the meeting so I can distribute internally.

From: security@acmecloud.com
To: laura-bennett@redwood.ai, samir.patel@acmecloud.com, pnair@gartner.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Temporary sandbox role created: ACME-GARTNER-DEMO-ROLE (expiry 2027-12-03T04:00:00Z)

Forwarded message:
> From: security@acmecloud.com
> To: laura-bennett@redwood.ai, pnair@gartner.com
> Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:40:00 -0800
> Subject: Temporary sandbox role created
>
> Hi all —
>
> We created a temporary read-only role: ACME-GARTNER-DEMO-ROLE. Scope: read-only to demo-bucket and describe/list on inference cluster. Expiry: 2027-12-03T04:00:00Z (36 hours). No access to production logs or PII.
>
> Credentials: ephemeral token will be emailed to the addresses on this thread once the session is scheduled.
>
> Attachment: sandbox-credentials-stub.txt (stub)
>
> Security Team
> AcmeCloud

Thanks — role ARN and expiry attached above. We’ve also uploaded the runbook to the secure share; link is in the calendar invite. Looking forward to the session.

—Samir
